name: Nicolas Rouleau
abstract_title: Superstitious conditioning shapes the experience of free will under causal determinism
abstract: The question of whether humans truly possess free will has long occupied philosophy, psychology, and neuroscience. Although the debate remains unresolved, neuropsychological evidence has lent weight to both determinist and compatibilist perspectives, each of which views choice as unfolding within a causally determined framework. authors: Nicolas Rouleau, Cooper Kansala, Emre Cicek, Vanessa Okoree, Andrew Golding, Nirosha Murugan
